summary: Alithya Group inc. filed a Form 6-K covering its fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 financial results along with a notice of annual general and special meeting. The filing reports revenues, margins, net loss, and adjusted metrics, but contains no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. This is a routine earnings and meeting notice filing, not a special situation. No special-situation event or transaction is disclosed.
